newsitem.title: USA: Burlington Air Express acquires Dutch firm.
newsitem.headline: Burlington Air Express acquires Dutch firm.

text.p: Burlington Air Express said it has acquired Dutch logistics firm Cleton & Company.
Burlington said in a statement that the Dutch firm had 1996 gross turnover of $30 million. Its operations will be folded into the Dutch logistics operations of Burlington.
C&C head Lex Cleton will become managing director of Burlington's expanded logistics operations in the Netherlands.
Cleton & Company has a staff of 170 operating over 500,000 square feet of warehouse and distribution facilities. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
